title: Subtract the two energy accounts
spoken: H before minus E before, less H after minus E after, equals L times gamma minus one.
explanation: Subtracting the rest-frame conservation equation from the moving-frame equation eliminates the unknown absolute energies. This arithmetic alone does not yet identify a kinetic-energy change.
assumptions: Two equal, opposite light pulses remove total positive energy L; their symmetry removes recoil in the body’s rest frame.
The two inertial descriptions refer to the same emission and the same body boundary; |v| < c.
These are authored modern teaching equations, not a transcription or printed-notation concordance.

notes.title: Moving-frame account before
notes.explanation: H₀ is the same body’s pre-emission energy described by the moving observer, not a second physical emission.

notes.title: Rest-frame account before
notes.explanation: E₀ is the body’s pre-emission energy in its rest description. Its absolute value remains unknown: no formula involving an assigned rest mass is inserted.

notes.title: Compare the pre-emission descriptions
notes.explanation: H₀ − E₀ compares two frame descriptions of the pre-emission body, not two different bodies.

notes.title: Moving-frame account after
notes.explanation: H₁ is the body’s post-emission energy in that same moving frame. The observer speed is unchanged between the two accounts.

notes.title: Rest-frame account after
notes.explanation: E₁ is the body’s remaining energy in the same rest description after both pulses leave. Before and after refer to the same body boundary.

notes.title: Compare the post-emission descriptions
notes.explanation: H₁ − E₁ compares those same frames after the same emission.

notes.title: Subtract the frame differences
notes.explanation: Taking the difference of these differences removes the unknown absolute energy levels. A kinetic interpretation still needs an additional premise.

notes.title: Emitted energy L
notes.explanation: Total energy of both opposite pulses, in the body’s rest frame. It is not the body’s unknown total energy.

notes.title: Modern Lorentz factor
notes.explanation: γ depends on the observer speed. In this modern teaching notation γ is the factor, not the speed ratio v/c. The transformation of the light energy is imported from relativity, not derived from these energy accounts.

notes.title: Subtract the rest-frame factor
notes.explanation: At zero relative speed γ is one. Subtracting one isolates the extra light energy in the moving account; it is not an independent mass-energy premise.

notes.title: Multiply the factors
notes.explanation: The two radiation totals differ by γL − L = L(γ − 1).

notes.title: What this relation asserts
notes.explanation: Subtracting the rest-frame conservation equation from the moving-frame equation eliminates the unknown absolute energies. This arithmetic alone does not yet identify a kinetic-energy change.

sentence.text: H before minus E before, less H after minus E after, equals L times gamma minus one.
